title: North Wharf Elementary asks for a pickup
caller_intent: Ask a parent to pick up a student who has a mild fever

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Elena Vasquez in the front office at North Wharf Elementary. I'm calling about a student whose parent contact is Alex Kim.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: This is an AI assistant for Alex Kim, and this call may be recorded. I can take a message for Alex. I won't share other family details.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The nurse says the student has a mild fever and is resting in the health room. This is not an emergency. We just need a pickup plan today.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll tell Alex. What should they do when they arrive?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A parent or the usual caregiver can come to the front office with a photo ID. We are not asking for money, medicine, or any account numbers.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood. Is there a direct number if Alex is already on the way?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The office is open until 4, and the direct line is 206-555-0194. Please note that we called and asked for a pickup today. That is the whole message.
